exceptions.card-tone: A card in a meaning's hue (purple, amber, green, red) and in four weights (tint, soft, outline, line), and the quiet grey card: brand's card has white and the teal tint only.
exceptions.label-caps: The label role as a mixin: labels in a meaning's or a column's hue (purple, amber, red, green), and the type of the stage strip, the gradient title pill and the gantt and table heads; brand's label has teal-dark, muted and ink only.
exceptions.callout-status: Amber and green callouts for a risk and a result, their text mixed 40 % into ink for 4.5:1: brand's callout has teal and purple only.
exceptions.code-panel: The website's code, Shiki github-dark on its own ground (website astro.config.mjs), in the slide's full brand corner: brand's hw-code sets night and its own palette, which the website's code does not use.
exceptions.number-tile: The KPI and number tile: a figure on a square tile, which no other system shows.
exceptions.chart-bars: Chart bars: a slide's data in the slide engine's context and highlight marks.
exceptions.slide-table: The slide table: projected rows at stage size with the slide's own column heads, kept per system.
exceptions.header-bars: Header bars: the roadmap column's bar and the factory frame's gradient title pill, kept per system.
exceptions.stage-status: The stage strip: the pipeline's stages with the active ones marked, a status no other system shows.
exceptions.stance-quote: The two sides of a stance face each other: the right one's rule stands on the right, each in its side's hue; brand's quote has a purple rule on the left only.
